svg.text: NumLayers=4, Type1, TypeAPosition=3, AdditionalPosition=0, 2 CDM groups without data
Teal=data; dark=reserved; yellow/purple=DMRS for that port (OCC partners can share REs).
1000/1001 on even comb; 1002/1003 on odd comb — Type1 + two CDM groups intuition.
UE/gNB estimates each layer via its port DMRS, then demodulates remaining data REs.
Aligned with common MATLAB toolbox demos; confirm exact maps in TS 38.211.
